biggest_catch: Referrals are capped at 10 per calendar year and only new memberships opened in 2026 qualify; the referred member must enter code REFER25 plus your name and email.
catches: Referrer earns $25 for each referral that results in a new membership account being opened, with a maximum of ten (10) referrals ($250) per calendar year.
New member account must be opened between 01/01/2026 and 12/31/2026; the new member must not be an existing member.
New member must enter the Refer-A-Friend Code 'REFER25' and provide the name and email address of the referring member on the application.
Reward deposited into the referring member's account within 60 days of the new membership opening.
Referring member must be in good standing; only one referral awarded per new membership.
AA CU employees, their immediate family/permanent household members, business accounts, and Credit Union Coordinators are not eligible to refer.
Membership restricted to aviation industry, immediate family, household members, and FAA-program students/instructors.
